title: Reduce the native carrier, setup and complete activation exponents
body:
This construction reduces the fixed carrier ranks and the input scale of a complete signed integer multiplier. At the complete κ of [PR #7981](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/7981), its largest binary rank falls from 2^236800000000000 to **2^1600000**. Two other installations use the same compiler. The largest matches the current conditional price **κ = 0.00389011527141** of [PR #8029](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/8029) using its own paid physical operations. [Construction and resource table](https://github.com/aliromman/integer-mult-bounds/blob/047d9f98a818ceb556813593f5e07a4f382687d4/research/single-band-native-carriers/README.md) · [Exact receipts](https://github.com/aliromman/integer-mult-bounds/blob/047d9f98a818ceb556813593f5e07a4f382687d4/research/single-band-native-carriers/REQUIREMENTS.json) · [Complete application](https://github.com/aliromman/integer-mult-bounds/blob/047d9f98a818ceb556813593f5e07a4f382687d4/research/single-band-native-carriers/APPLICATION.md)

| Quantity | Physical predecessor | Compact | Higher rate | Current price match |
| --- | ---: | ---: | ---: | ---: |
| Complete κ | 0.00387992803556 | 0.00387992803556 | 0.00389011519729 | 0.00389011527141 |
| log₂ largest binary rank | 236,800,000,000,000 | 1,600,000 | 224,000,000,000 | 1,568,000,000,000 |
| log₂ numerical rank | 3,300,000,000 | 610,000 | 1,600,000 | 1,600,000 |
| log₂ largest fixed setup envelope | 4,736,000,000,000,000,000 | 1,638,400,000 | 229,376,000,000,000 | 1,605,632,000,000,000 |
| A for complete activation at p ≥ 2^A | 355,763,540,965,264 | 2,471,428 | 267,186,701,153 | 1,870,297,303,584 |

Here p = 6 ceil(log₂ n) for the larger significant operand length n. The complete bound is S + C n(1 + log n)^(1 − κ). Compact reduces the binary, fixed setup and activation exponents by 148,000,000×, 2,890,625,000× and about 143,950,599×. The middle installation still clears 1,000× on all four resource exponents. Matching the last digits of the newest price gives smaller reductions of 151× in the binary exponent and 190× in A against the physical predecessor. Its comparator used a binary rank exponent of 299,610,000,000,000. All activation thresholds are sufficient. The first covered input has 2^(ceil(2^A / 6) − 1) + 1 bits. [Physical baseline](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/blob/9585c1fa2ed5f2316ac09e04b357cb720badfcb8/research/triangular-native-supplier/README.md) · [Newest comparator and its premises](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/blob/c3837013dd7e2c50f6c3065c8f99d52a33b617bb/research/p104-paired-delayed-cover/weighted/moment/PROOF.md)

A single chronological band lends each paid job in its true frame. Its real column prefix returns to the caller after the residual axes have been served. The strict moment surplus pays this loss. One stored epoch serves every round and recursive activation, including charged seeks to resume suspended callers. The binary word checks every changed projector. The positive word regenerates all 2,971 Clifford transports and 104 port pairs from its literal circuit. The finite setup bound is the sum of the installed dimensions raised to 1,024. The old bound used degree 20,000. [Band proof and generation bill](https://github.com/aliromman/integer-mult-bounds/blob/047d9f98a818ceb556813593f5e07a4f382687d4/research/single-band-native-carriers/BAND.md) · [Epoch implementation](https://github.com/aliromman/integer-mult-bounds/blob/047d9f98a818ceb556813593f5e07a4f382687d4/research/single-band-native-carriers/epoch_tape.py) · [Physical binary proof](https://github.com/aliromman/integer-mult-bounds/blob/047d9f98a818ceb556813593f5e07a4f382687d4/research/single-band-native-carriers/STRONG-BINARY.md) · [Physical numerical proof](https://github.com/aliromman/integer-mult-bounds/blob/047d9f98a818ceb556813593f5e07a4f382687d4/research/single-band-native-carriers/STRONG-COMPLEX.md)

Independently, a coprime-square sieve replaces the quadratic minimum axis width with a linear width. At the same compact input, one old allocated root matrix requires at least 2^1501199875790166 entries. All new per-input private generation costs at most 2^1468548787717 transitions. The comparison includes extra axes, exact coefficient generation, numerical guards, true-coordinate recovery and carry. The complete space bound from each entrance is below 297.6n bits for canonical inputs. The two higher-rate installations have an additional width factor e^(1/50000) in the cofinal bound on the **logarithm** of the quotient reserve. [Sieve, private setup and connected entrance](https://github.com/aliromman/integer-mult-bounds/blob/047d9f98a818ceb556813593f5e07a4f382687d4/research/single-band-native-carriers/LINEAR-GEOMETRY.md) · [Storage and head travel](https://github.com/aliromman/integer-mult-bounds/blob/047d9f98a818ceb556813593f5e07a4f382687d4/research/single-band-native-carriers/ACTIVATION-SPACE.md) · [Signed product entry](https://github.com/aliromman/integer-mult-bounds/blob/047d9f98a818ceb556813593f5e07a4f382687d4/research/single-band-native-carriers/band_product.py)

### Verification

Use CPython 3.12 and the standard library. The Lean check additionally requires Lean 4.34.1 and the pinned mathlib packages.

```sh
python3.12 -B scripts/research_package.py --package research/single-band-native-carriers
python3.12 -IB research/single-band-native-carriers/verify_formal.py
```

```text
PASS_REGISTERED_RESEARCH_PACKAGE research/single-band-native-carriers outcome=completed
PASS_NATIVE_SCALE_KERNEL 18 axiom reports ['Classical.choice', 'Quot.sound', 'propext']
```

Eight portable checks cover finite flow, dense arithmetic, physical graph replays, exact prices, storage and product tapes. The signed Fourier regression returned −345550037539, with coefficient sequence [11811, 10996, 4152, 868, 77], 157,248 H calls and 138 physical rank-two CRT shuttles. Kernel replay covers the general finite-flow and return identities, sieve indicator, full-width stripe bounds and fourteen ordinary funding inequalities. The all-size proof connecting physical instructions, bit heights, numerical recovery and Turing-machine costs is written. The production-dimensional installations remain far beyond execution. The least recurring constant and practical crossover are unknown. [Evidence and limits](https://github.com/aliromman/integer-mult-bounds/blob/047d9f98a818ceb556813593f5e07a4f382687d4/research/single-band-native-carriers/VERIFICATION.md) · [Lean proofs](https://github.com/aliromman/integer-mult-bounds/tree/047d9f98a818ceb556813593f5e07a4f382687d4/research/single-band-native-carriers/lean) · [Portable manifest](https://github.com/aliromman/integer-mult-bounds/blob/047d9f98a818ceb556813593f5e07a4f382687d4/research/single-band-native-carriers/VERIFY.json)
